items.title: Quanta Services (PWR) Adds Ellen Rubin To Board As AI Power Demand Builds
items.summary: Quanta Services (NYSE:PWR) appointed Ellen Rubin, an experienced AI and cloud technology executive, to its Board of Directors. Rubin brings leadership experience from several AI and cloud-focused companies, including roles tied to large scale data infrastructure. The board refresh comes as Quanta targets more work related to power, data centers, and energy needs linked to AI computing.
